hadith:
To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq) - Narrated `Aisha:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The people will be gathered barefooted, naked, and uncircumcised." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will the men and the women look at each other?" He said, "The situation will be too hard for them to pay attention to that."
message: On the Day of Judgment, we will stand alone before Allah and cannot blame others for our choices, as each person bears responsibility for their own faith and actions. In facing this reality with humility, we find peace through trusting in Allah, As-Salaam—the Source of Peace—who guides those who sincerely seek His path and turn to Him with a tender heart. Let this inspire us today to choose righteousness consciously, seeking Allah's peace through obedience rather than following others astray.
name:
As Salaam - السَّلاَمُ - The Source of Peace

Originating from Arabic, the name 'As Salaam' highlights Allah's nature as the one who provides peace and serenity to His creation. It emphasizes a key attribute of Allah, fostering a sense of calm and security for believers. The invocation of this name is often used in prayers and supplications, seeking divine peace in one's life.
verse:
As-Saffat - Those who set the Ranks - 37:28-29

The misled will say, “It was you who deluded us away from what is right.”
